allOf.$comment: A magic item's grants use only the keys the Engine's item grants contract allows; the Engine checks their fields.

ruleset.$comment: The profile a rules engine evaluates characters with. It follows the Engine's ruleset validation so a profile the Engine would refuse cannot install; rules that compare two fields are checked in tests/data-integrity.mts.
